Use case: illustration-story. Create one LANDSCAPE production storyboard sheet with exactly FOUR equal 16:9 panels in a clean 2-by-2 grid, thin white gutters. Each panel is a single cinematic still, not multiple events. Use the attached named character masters as identity references and attached environments as layout references. Preserve faces, ages, clothing and relative heights. Original polished stylized 3D family animation. No speech balloons and no generated dialogue text. Small shot ID labels only at lower-left of each panel. Panels in reading order:
Panel 1, S29: Visible characters DAN, LEO. Medium two-shot; Dan crouches slightly to Leo's eye level. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Call ended; phone in right pocket; Dan holds lists; emotional tone reassuring.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Dan ends the call, pockets his phone and admits the error. Leo listens without laughing at him. A short quiet beat gives the emotion room.
Panel 2, S30: Visible characters ELLA, MAX. Medium child two-shot; Ella left, Max right. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Blue and yellow totes open beside basket, ready to sort.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Ella holds the blue tote open. Max holds the yellow tote open. They offer a simple sorting plan and smile toward Dan off-screen.
Panel 3, S31: Visible characters LEO, ELLA. Counter-level two-shot with BLUE tote; exact counts supplied by insert overlays. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Blue tote contains four carrots, three tomatoes, one cucumber, one lettuce, one red pepper.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): Leo reads the blue list. Show the salad items already grouped together beside the open blue tote after a small sorting ellipsis at the cut. Ella places the final red pepper in the tote; the other salad items are already inside. Use the educational insert for the full exact-count inventory.
Panel 4, S32: Visible characters DAN, MAX. Counter-level two-shot with YELLOW tote; Dan left, Max right. Location: MARKET_STALL. Depict ONLY this ending state as a single still: Yellow tote filled correctly; woven basket empty; notes attached to matching tote handles with clips.. Action context for expressions (do not show multiple stages or duplicate an object in two places): After a second small sorting ellipsis at the cut, the yellow tote already holds potatoes, onions, broccoli and corn. Dan places the final spinach bag inside while Max steadies the tote. The woven basket is empty on the counter. Notes are already clipped to matching handles at this cut.
Keep blue and yellow list papers BLANK for later exact editorial text. Never draw invented food labels or duplicate blue-list contents on yellow paper. Each selected vegetable exists once; if it has been placed in the basket, it is no longer also in a hand or on the counter. Unpurchased crate stock is separate. Exact quantities apply only to selected produce. Use unobtrusive background blur for stock. The source images in order are: DAN, LEO, ELLA, MAX, MARKET_STALL. Select ONLY the named cast for each panel; a lineup source does not mean all people appear in every panel. Do not merge people, duplicate a cast member in a panel, change clothes or invent an extra child. Storyboard only; no claim of animated video.
Prioritize these continuity fixes: S29 has only Dan and Leo, Dan holds exactly two blank sheets BLUE and YELLOW, phone fully pocketed. In S30 Ella and Max hold visibly EMPTY open blue and yellow totes; no vegetables protrude. In S31 show only the upper rim of the BLUE tote with exactly one red bell pepper just inside, Ella's hands now empty; all other salad contents are below the rim, not spread on counter; Leo holds blank blue sheet. In S32 only Dan and Max; YELLOW tote with a single clear spinach bag just inside, all other contents hidden below rim; empty woven basket visible to the side; a blank yellow note clipped on yellow handle and a blank blue note on the visible blue tote handle. No selected vegetables outside their containers and no duplicate spinach. Keep Dan's watch only on anatomical LEFT wrist. Preserve original portraits and striped-awning background. 2048x1152 landscape.
